rs1142345.sentence: Genotypes AG + GG of rs1142345 are not associated with increased risk of leukopenia when treated with azathioprine in people with Autoimmune Hepatitis (AIH), AIH–Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) variant syndrome, and related cirrhosis in China as compared to genotype AA.
rs1142345.explanation: In a cohort of 149 Chinese AIH/AIH–PBC variant patients genotyped for TPMT rs1142345, the study reported no significant association with AZA-induced leukopenia or maintenance dose; the risk-allele frequency was low (~1.7%), which may have limited power.

rs116855232.sentence: Genotype CT of rs116855232 is associated with increased risk of leukopenia when treated with azathioprine in people with Autoimmune Hepatitis (AIH), AIH–Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) variant syndrome, and related cirrhosis in China as compared to genotype CC.
rs116855232.explanation: The single-center study of 149 Chinese AIH/AIH–PBC variant patients found a significant association between NUDT15 rs116855232 and AZA-induced leukopenia; heterozygotes also tolerated and maintained remission on lower AZA doses (~1 mg/kg/day), and showed a lower AZA dose-to-6-TGN concentration ratio.

rs147390019.sentence: rs147390019 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs147390019.explanation: The variant (NUDT15 p.Arg139His) was cited from prior literature as relevant to thiopurine toxicity but was not genotyped or analyzed in this AIH/AIH–PBC azathioprine cohort.
